notes: Most of the previous review was fixed, and the main path for a first-time band now holds together. The public screen shows nothing personal and has one call to action. Returning wallets see 'Reconnecting your wallet…' instead of a flash of the connect screen. The band name starts empty. One large 'Create your first tour' button leads to a wizard that asks exactly four questions with sensible defaults. The route preview now shows the money and the risk before booking (full house, the half-the-tickets bar, refunds). Booking is a single wallet approval, with plain error messages and a 'Finish booking' step if it stops part-way. After booking, the dashboard reads as the band's own: planned days survive (Day 1, 3, 6), it says 'booked by you', the stepper is shorter, it says what the band is waiting on, and nobody is promised a replacement they cannot get. Activity is gated and filtered to the band's own shows, and Venues and Planner no longer call the demo tour 'yours'. The remaining problems start at the moment the band 'lets it run'. The wizard promised about €117,000 at a full house, and the dashboard then shows 'Your share 0.00156 SOL' and '4 / 20 sold' for a band that brings 1,000 people. It shows 'Nov 3' next to 'deadline 29m 54s', with no word that this is a demo clock and a 1-in-20 sample. Clicking one of the band's own shows opens a page titled with an account address, with a buy box, 'vault ↗' and 'Anyone can run the crank'. Activity lines never say which city they are about, and the empty text 'nothing else has happened yet' also shows while the feed is loading, sitting next to 16 sold tickets. 'New tour' is the primary button while a tour is still selling, and booking again hides that tour. Phones still hide Band record and Activity behind a faded scroller, and Venues is still a 15,000 px page. The UI bot's phone screenshots of band pages all show the connect screen, so the connected dashboard and wizard at 390 px were never checked.
issues: packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:324-326, components/ShowCard.tsx:43, app/show/page.tsx:173-177, lib/chain-live.ts:121-122: the wizard sells the tour in euros at real room size ('Full house about €117,000', 'room 1,600'). Once booked, the dashboard shows 'Ticket money held 0.0032 SOL', 'Your share 0.00156 SOL' and '4 / 20 sold · need 10', and the feed says 'Refunded 0.0057 SOL'. The first thing a musician sees after 'let it run' contradicts what they were promised. Fix: one money formatter that turns lamports back into € (LAMPORTS_PER_EURO) and the devnet sample back into people (÷ SAMPLE), used on the dashboard, show cards, show page and feed, with SOL only in a 'details' disclosure. Add one line on the dashboard: 'Demo: 1 ticket stands for 20 fans; a tour day is 2 seconds'.

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:59-75,118-120: the show page looks a show up in getRun().band.authority's tour, which is the bundled demo band, never in the connected wallet's. A band clicking its own show card (dashboard Shows grid or itinerary) lands on a page titled '4KSa…T8z', with no city, venue or day. Fix: resolve through useBandSession().wallet with fetchLiveTour first and fall back to the demo run. Then give the band a band view (status, what happens next, back to the tour) instead of the fan's 'Buy 1 for 0.0003 SOL' box.

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:111-124 and components/Feed.tsx:95-100: the band's activity lines never name the show: 'Fan 2gQnFr… bought 1 ticket (4 sold so far)', 'Threshold met (12/20): show confirmed', 'Refunded … to 2gQnFr…'. A three-city tour cannot be read, and the lines use chain words ('Proposed', 'threshold', wallet prefixes). While events are still loading, Feed prints the 'empty' text, so the dashboard says 'Your shows are booked; nothing else has happened yet' next to 16 sold tickets and a confirmed show (7-booked-dashboard.png). Fix: map data.show to its city through the tour's shows and lead each line with it ('Hamburg: a fan bought 1 ticket, 12 of 20'), drop wallet prefixes, and keep a separate loading state ('Reading what happened…') apart from the empty one.

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:268-272 + lib/chain-live.ts:68-69: while a tour is selling, the only green button on the dashboard is 'New tour', so the obvious next step contradicts 'let it run'. Booking again silently replaces the running tour on the dashboard, because only toursCreated-1 is read. Fix: while any show is proposed, on sale or confirmed, demote 'New tour' to an outline button with a confirm ('Your current tour keeps running; it moves to Past tours'), and list earlier tours under the current one.

components/ShowCard.tsx:50 + app/page.tsx:313-331: the cards say 'Day 1 · Nov 3' and then 'deadline 29m 54s' and 'show 1h 0m', and the stepper says 'Route OK' and 'Settled'. Nothing on the dashboard explains the compressed demo clock, so a band reads it as a show in one hour on the wrong date. Fix: phrase countdowns as 'ticket sales close in 30 min (demo time)', rename the steps Booked → Venues signed → On sale → Going ahead → Paid out, and drop the duplicated 'Confirmed' stat (it appears in both the stepper and the stats row).

packages/web/src/app/globals.css:1097-1104 and components/Connect.tsx:25-27: at 390 px the nav is still a horizontal scroller that cuts off at 'Route plan'. A fade mask was added, but Band record and Activity, which the band asked for, stay off-screen behind a swipe, and gated phone pages still show the 'Greenroom' brand twice (phone-*.png). Fix: a bottom tab bar with four items (Home, Venues, Activity, Record; Planner and Approvals behind Home), and hide .welcome .brand under 896 px.

packages/web/src/app/venues/page.tsx:158-212: Venues is still not compact. On a phone it is one 15,027 px page (phone-venues.png) with all 136 venues open, each with a '+ Plan' pill, under two toolbars of filters. 'No venues match these filters' (line 213) offers no reset. Fix: one collapsed <details> row per city (drive, venue count, capacity range) that opens on tap, a single 'Filter' button on small screens, and a 'Clear filters' button in the empty state.

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:96-97,427 + components/WalletPanel.tsx:51-94: the first thing on the band's home screen, before the band name, is still a chain strip ('Your wallet cSppNh…', '1.5 SOL devnet', 'Settled shows', 'Tickets you hold: waiting for devnet…', which stays there on public RPCs that refuse getProgramAccounts). The copy says 'Your band is on-chain'. Fix: move the strip into the wallet button's menu (or a collapsed 'Wallet' row below the tour), drop 'Tickets you hold' from the band view, and change line 427 to 'You're set up. Time for the first tour.'

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:313-360: after booking, the dashboard repeats the same facts four times: a stepper, six stat tiles, the itinerary with status badges, and a Shows grid with the same three shows. The band asked for compact information that opens on demand, and on a phone the route sits below about 1.5 screens of counters. Fix: one summary line (tickets sold, money in €, shows going ahead / at risk), then the itinerary with each stop's progress bar inline that expands into the show card on tap; remove the separate Shows grid.

packages/web/src/app/planner/page.tsx:113-118,222-235: 'Open in route planner →' on the dashboard (?from=tour) silently overwrites the band's saved sketch with savePlan(tourIds). The planner then reschedules the tour with its own rest rule, so dates differ from the dashboard (Nov 3/4/5 against Nov 3/5/8). 'Load my tour' and 'Clear' also wipe the plan with no undo. 'Ready to book? Create a tour' does not carry the stops into the wizard. Phone width still shows an empty ~120 px band under the nav (phone-planner.png). Fix: keep the tour's real days when loading it, never overwrite without an undo toast, pre-fill the wizard's start city from the plan, and find what stretches the header row at 390 px.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:19 + components/Connect.tsx:66-170: every band starts its tour in Berlin, because registration never asks the home city and the wizard does not remember the last start. Fix: ask 'Where are you based?' at registration (one select), or store the last start city in localStorage, and use it as the default.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:58-71 + lib/book.ts:156-211: busy is only set when bookTour calls onStatus after its RPC reads, so 'Book this tour' stays clickable for a second or two after the first click. A double tap starts two booking flows, and the second fails with a raw account-in-use error. Fix: call setBusy('Preparing…') at the start of book(), before the dynamic import.

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:121-127,190,215-221,256, components/Connect.tsx:104,113-114,138, app/band/page.tsx:70-89, app/approvals/page.tsx:62: chain words remain on band-facing screens: 'show account ↗', 'vault ↗', 'escrow', 'Anyone can run the crank: check threshold', 'held in escrow', 'rent', 'Settled shows', 'Gross settled', 'profile ↗', 'Nothing goes on-chain'. Registration errors are shown raw (Connect.tsx:104). Fix: hide the explorer, vault and crank links in a 'Details' disclosure, use 'held until the show', 'needed to go ahead', 'paid out' and 'deposit', and pass register errors through bookingErrorText.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:191-217 + components/Approvals.tsx:346-357,390: the wizard's route is take-it-or-leave-it. In 4-route-preview.png Berlin is followed by '4 days off' before a 179 km drive, and the band can neither drop a stop nor pull a date closer, while the Approvals route card offers per-stop keep toggles and 'Decline'. Approvals still counts down in raw seconds ('lapses in about 287s'). Fix: share one RouteReview with stop toggles between the wizard and Approvals, explain long gaps ('no free room in Leipzig before Nov 8'), and show countdowns as 'about 5 min'.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:125: the custom ticket price clamps on every keystroke (Number('') || 1), so deleting '20' to type '35' produces '1', then '13'. Fix: keep the raw string in state and clamp on blur or on Plan my tour.

packages/web/src/app/approvals/page.tsx:39-45: a band whose tour is already running is told 'Create a tour' as the only action on Approvals, and for wizard bands the nav item is a permanent empty page. Fix: when the band has a live tour, link 'Follow your tour' instead, and hide the Approvals nav item (or show its count only) for tours booked in the wizard.
